t:type.name: DriverMatchCriterion
t:type.t:description: One test on a device attribute from a driver's matcher.

t:attribute.name: attribute
t:attribute.description: The name of the device attribute being tested, such as ZWAV:Manufacturer.

t:attribute.name: comparison
t:attribute.description: How the attribute is compared with the value. EQUALS: the attribute equals the value. REGEX: the attribute contains a match for the regular expression in the value. IN: the attribute equals one of the values, written as [a, b]. CONTAINS: the attribute is a set that contains the value.

t:attribute.name: value
t:attribute.description: The value the attribute is compared with. Numbers are written in decimal.
